create_ModularArithmetic_task: create a ModularArithmetic task with a given modulus and optional operators for generating training data
sample_batch_expressions: sample a batch of modular arithmetic expressions with one-hot encoded inputs and labels using a JAX RNG
evaluate_expression: evaluate a modular arithmetic expression encoded as a JAX array under a given modulus
replace_subtractions: replace subtractions in an encoded expression with additions using modular inverses
perform_multiplications: perform all multiplications in an expression containing only addition and multiplication operators
